CustomField.description: Controls whether record and user folders in Google Drive follow the current names of their records and users. When enabled, a folder whose record was renamed, or whose folder name pattern changed, takes its new name the next time a file is added to it. Leave this off to keep every folder name as it is.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Renames a record's or user's folder in Google Drive to its current name the next time a file is added to it. Leave this off to keep every folder name as it is.
CustomField.label: Is Folder Rename Enabled?
